name: Motorcar Parts of America
outlook:
What Motorcar Parts of America says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: net salesReflecting delayed customer orders for existing and new business awards, the company is revising its guidance for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. Net sales are estimated to be between $715 million and $740 million (previously $780 million to $800 million).
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 9, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
